status: PRE-REGISTERED (frozen before the full run; smoke run on validation only)
question: Is the "SAEs never beat PCA" finding a property of error-matching (PCA k=298-519 for trained SAEs, 143-164 for the random decoder) rather than of the SAEs?

splits.owt_eval: OWT validation cache (12,700 tokens/layer; 100 sequences for splicing)

references.capacity_k128: PCA k=128 = OWT L0 target of every SAE
references.error_matched: PCA k at the SAE OWT validation NMSE (replicates the existing reference)

rules.got: per family x layer x reference, from per-seed paired grouped-bootstrap 95% CIs of (SAE gap - PCA gap), 1000 resamples shared within a layer: SAE BETTER if every seed CI high < 0; SAE WORSE if every seed CI low > 0; EQUIVALENT (±0.02) if every seed CI within [-0.02, 0.02]; else INCONCLUSIVE
rules.owt: SAE BETTER / WORSE if so on every seed against PCA-128 (deterministic given rows); else MIXED

interpretation.I1: If error-matched comparisons on validation are SAE WORSE or INCONCLUSIVE (never SAE BETTER) for trained SAEs, the error-matched headline is replicated on validation and stays, but must be stated as error-matched with the k range.
interpretation.I2: If any trained SAE family is SAE BETTER at capacity_k128 or task_l0_matched on the primary metric, "SAEs never beat PCA" is not true without qualification: the paper must say SAEs lose more truth information than PCA at equal error but not at equal active-dimension budget. This is a conclusion change: report to the user before revising the paper.
interpretation.I3: If capacity-matched comparisons are INCONCLUSIVE/EQUIVALENT, the paper must say the SAE-vs-PCA conclusion depends on the matching criterion and is not established at equal capacity.

limitations: PCA-k is a fixed k-dim subspace; a TopK SAE chooses k of 12,288 (or 3,072) latents per token from a learned dictionary, so k=128 is an equal per-token active budget, not equal parameters or equal representational capacity.
OWT L0 is not GoT task L0 for ReLU/BatchTopK/JumpReLU (S10); task_l0_matched addresses this only for the GoT readout.
Validation rows only: GoT val n=448 (224 city groups); seeds share one data stream.
Descriptive diagnostic: no multiplicity correction across cells; classifications are per family.
